content: User-space virtual drive DLP runs as a user-mode application/service presenting a protected drive letter using frameworks like WinFsp or Dokany, requiring no signed kernel driver and isolating failures from the OS kernel, but enforcement is limited to files inside the virtual drive and can be bypassed by privileged users or applications. Kernel-mode file-system filter DLP uses minifilter drivers to intercept all IRPs system-wide, providing tamper-resistant real-time blocking and rich process/user context, but requires signed drivers, rigorous compatibility testing, and carries BSOD/stability risk.
